{{Quote|When Paarkos is finished, you will be protected against the Megasecurity Ward's traps.|Paarkos|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Paarkos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], who for unknown crimes was imprisoned in the [[Belsavis prison]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]] he was sprung out of his cell along with three other prisoners - [[Chaney Barrow]], [[Ohta]] and [[Kanjon Slyke]]. Their rescuer posed as a fellow inmate, but was in fact [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operative [[Cipher Nine]]. The prisoners released were chosen for their skills and were asked to provide means to break into the [[Megasecurity Ward 23]]. To avoid the attention by [[SCORPIO]] security system, they came up with a plan to reprogram security droids and order them to cause havoc, thus triggering multiple alarms at different locations at once, overloading SCORPIO's capabilities. The plan eventually worked, though SCORPIO managed to disconnect herself from the network and upload her consciousness back into the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] body.
